description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the 'OpenvasOutputProcessor' class, testing its ability to parse OpenVAS XML scan results. It includes setup, data providers, and multiple test methods that verify vulnerabilities parsing, host and port extraction, and CVSS data handling.

classes.name: OpenvasOutputProcessorTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the OpenvasOutputProcessor's capabilities to process and parse OpenVAS scan XML files, focusing on vulnerabilities, host and port parsing, and CVSS data extraction.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the OpenvasOutputProcessor instance before each test.

methods.name: dataProviderTestFiles
methods.description: Provides test data files and expected vulnerabilities count for parameterized tests.

methods.name: testVulnerabilitiesParsing
methods.description: Verifies that the processor correctly counts vulnerabilities from the test XML files.

methods.name: testParseHostsAndPorts
methods.description: Checks if the processor correctly parses host and port assets from the XML file.

methods.name: testParseVulnerabilities
methods.description: Ensures vulnerabilities are parsed with correct descriptions and count from the test file.

methods.name: testParseVulnerabilitiesIncludingCvssData
methods.description: Verifies that CVSS vector data is correctly extracted from vulnerabilities.
